# What's already in the box

Field's standard library is large and, until now, invisible: the only ways to read it were to open the source or to already know the name you wanted. This section is a browsable map of it — every public declaration in `afield.stdlib` and `afield.visualization`, with the KDoc that sits next to it in the source.

**3668 public symbols across 61 source files**, 380 of them (10%) carrying a KDoc summary. Pages are grouped by the `@file:CompletionCategory` label the source itself carries, which is the same grouping the editor's autocomplete uses.

The "documented" column is the honest one: it is a coverage report on Field's own KDoc, not a claim about this page. Where a summary is blank the declaration has none yet.

| Category | Files | Symbols | Documented | Covers |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Math](math.md) | 14 | 1287 | 128 (9%) | Numerics: signal processing in both domains, estimation and fitting, interpolation, statistics, randomness and units. |
| [Data](data.md) | 15 | 587 | 63 (10%) | Structures and processes over data rather than over pixels: clustering and nearest-neighbour search, generative and constraint systems, graph dynamics, and the I/O helpers (files, JSON, subprocesses, OSC-adjacent devices) that get data into a box. |
| [Graphics](graphics.md) | 14 | 1001 | 78 (7%) | Everything that ends up as an `FLine`, a colour or a shader: drawing helpers, contouring, geometry, colour spaces, keyframing and the small shading languages' host side. |
| [Function](function.md) | 10 | 339 | 84 (24%) | The function algebra — Field's first-class, evolvable, graph-rewritable notion of a function. |
| [Visualization](visualization.md) | 4 | 225 | 13 (5%) | Turning a value into something you can look at, without leaving the box. |
| [Audio](audio.md) | 2 | 153 | 9 (5%) | Sound analysis and the network protocols that carry control data alongside it. |
| [Workspace](workspace.md) | 2 | 76 | 5 (6%) | The box's own surroundings: properties, persistence, and the handful of names every box already has in scope. |

## What is not here

- **The generated vector algebra** (`afield.stdlib.linalg`) has its own, better page: [Generated vector API reference](../linear_algebra_api.md), with [Linear algebra in Field](../linear_algebra.md) for the intuition.
- **Declarations marked `Internal`** by their own `@file:CompletionCategory` are plumbing, and are excluded on purpose.
- **Graphics, rendering and the small languages beyond their host side** live in `afield.four`, `afield.rectsl` and `afield.stacksl`; start from [afield.four Graphics](../afield_four_graphics.md), the [RectSL cheatsheet](../rectsl_cheatsheet.md) and the [StackSL cheatsheet](../stacksl_cheatsheet.md).

## How to read a symbol you find here

Type its name in a box and press `ctrl-space`: the [completion documentation panel](../completion_doc_browser.md) shows the same KDoc with every resolvable `[Symbol]` reference turned into a link you can follow, plus a jump straight to the definition's line in the source. This reference and that panel read the same declarations through the same parser, so anything listed here resolves there.

To search rather than browse, see [The Semantic Index](../semantic_index.md).
